Wilson score binomial confidence interval for proportions

Source: R/confidence_intervals.R
prop_ci.Rd

A Wilson score-based CI calculation for a proportion. Based on guidance by PHE

Usage

prop_ci(o, n, ci = 0.95)

Arguments

o

observed or numerator value

n

expected or denominator value

ci

confidence interval coverage required. Default is 0.95 for 95\ confidence interval

Value

A data.frame with Rate = o/n, lower confidence interval limit, and upper confidence interval limit

Examples

prop_ci(50,120)
#>        Rate   LowerCI   UpperCI
#> 1 0.4166667 0.3323835 0.5061197
